The generating-function decomposition and four-run counting are exact formal identities. The included standard-library verifier directly compares full run triples for 1330 words, with independent series checks; finite checks are supporting tests only.

value.rationale: A natural primitive in string algorithms is the maximal periodic run. The theorem is a complete structural solution for a sparse infinite word class: exact locations/periods, sharp constant maximal count independent of total length, full rational bivariate distribution and an exact asymptotic density of extremizers. That is a meaningful complete classification, not a routine renaming or unmotivated finite sample; the distinction from universal linear bounds motivates the gap.
